svg.title: Nightingale architecture
svg.desc: Nightingale queries existing Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, Elasticsearch, Loki, ClickHouse, and PostgreSQL data sources. Query results pass through alert rule evaluation, event processing, and notification routing. Alerts are delivered to Slack, PagerDuty, Discord, Email, Telegram, and Jira. The AI agent and MCP server are built into Nightingale.
